description: Aéroport de la Rochelle Programme de vols Hiver 2020 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Aéroport La Rochelle-Ile de Ré. This is the presentation of flight schedules at the departure and arrival of La Rochelle Airport, Ile de Ré for the period from 25/10/2020 to 27/03/2021 (Flights programme for the Winter 2020/2021) aeronautical season. Coverage: Aéroport La Rochelle-Ile de Ré. The portal shows the English title as "La Rochelle Airport Winter 2020 Flight Program" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Aéroport La Rochelle-Ile de Ré. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2020-10-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
